### Daugavpils zonālais valsts arhīvs

`branch` · [Website / directory](https://www.arhivi.gov.lv/lv/strukturvieniba/zonalie-valsts-arhivi)

The Latvian National Archives lists Daugavpils zonālais valsts arhīvs as a territorial unit. Its service territory and local institutional fonds are the starting point for recent administrative or personnel research. Earlier parish, revision and imperial records may be held centrally; consult the historical archive and Raduraksti rather than assuming local custody from the modern place name.
